title: Scaling Qubit Mapping and Routing With Position Graph Abstraction and Memoization
summary: Scalable qubit mapping and routing remain major bottlenecks in quantum compilation, especially for Trapped-Ion Quantum Charge-Coupled device (TI-QCCD) architectures, where qubit interactions require physically shuttling ions under strict movement, congestion, and trap-capacity constraints. We present a compilation framework built around the position graph abstraction, a unified representation of executable locations, movement paths, and routing constraints that enables heuristic mappers to operate directly on shuttling-based hardware.
